name: clipboard
title: Clipboard
summary: Copies a value such as an API key, a link or a command.
description: Copy a value: an API key, a link, a command. Copy a value. The trigger is the code block's Copy button: the Button with two states in one cell (Copy, then Copied, cross-fading and tinted green while the copied state lasts). variant button is that button alone; variant field puts an icon-only Copy button inside the end of a read-only Input that shows the value (an API key, a link). The change is announced through a status region. Behaviour comes from the Zag clipboard machine, through Ark UI.

anatomy.description: data-copied while the copied state lasts (from the engine)
field only: holds the input and the trigger
field only: the real Input, read-only, marked data-clipboard="input"; its end padding keeps the trigger's room (28px xs, 30px sm, 34px md, 36px lg), so a long value is cut before the button

The real Button (ghost, xs, muted), marked data-clipboard="trigger", swapped while copied: copy and check icons share one cell and cross-fade; green while copied. button: rounded, with the two labels (Copy, Copied) in one cell; as wide as the label it shows. field: square, icon only, in the real Tooltip, 4px inside the field's end (1px at sm). aria-label stays Copy; disabled when the value is empty.
Visually hidden role=status: says Copied while the copied state lasts

value.description: The text placed on the clipboard (and shown in the field).

variant.description: button: the code block's Copy button. field: a read-only Input showing the value, with an icon-only Copy button inside its end.

size.description: field only: the Input's sizes (`lib/control.ts`): xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px.

label.description: field only: visible label; otherwise pass aria-label.

labels.description: { copy, copied }: the button's labels and the announcement. Default Copy / Copied.

timeout.description: How long Copied shows, in ms (the code block's).

events.copy: (text: string) once the text is on the clipboard

keyboard: Tab reaches the field (read-only, its text selectable) and the button
Space / Enter on the button copy
notes: The button's name stays Copy (its two stacked labels are aria-hidden); the status region announces Copied.
The field's icon-only button is named by its Tooltip and its aria-label.
A read-only field keeps its text selectable, so the value can also be copied by hand.

motion: the two states cross-fade: opacity and a 2px blur over duration.base (the Button's swapped)
colour: green while copied, over duration.fast
press: the Button's (motion.press-scale over duration.press, easing.out-strong)
a copy from the keyboard swaps the same way: the change is the feedback
